matching: Findings are matched by the provisions they cite, not by requirement id. The best candidate is the finding whose citations are most focused on the listed provisions.
design: Variant of case 01 in which the practice has done everything within its own control: keys held only in A1, notice to the A1 Commission 52 days before the first transfer, impact assessment, return instead of deletion, no access from Region B. Region A's law cannot close its gates on its own text: A-REG 8(2)(c) rests 'on the basis of Subregion law' (A1-HIA 4, 5), A-REG 8(3)/21(3) bring in A1-HIA 6, and A-REG 18(2)-(3) asks whether Region B law would defeat the clauses, which turns on B-RAA 3 ('accessible to it') and B-RAA 5 (no duty to produce keys it does not hold). Without the A1 delegation and the Region B answer, those gates should stay undetermined (needs_review); with them, every gate is met. Case 01 is the contrast: same parties, host-held keys, do_not_proceed.
